name: Indutrade AB (publ)
summary: Indutrade AB (publ) manufactures, develops, and sells components, systems, and services to various industries worldwide. It operates through five segments: Industrial & Engineering, Infrastructure & Construction, Life Science, Process, Energy & Water, and Technology & Systems Solutions. The company offers industrial equipment, tools, filters, hydraulics, fasteners, and chemical technology for general engineering and automotive industries; and flow technology products, including valves, pipes and pipe systems, and pumps, as well as measurement technology and industrial equipment for energy sector, water and wastewater, and process industries.
